# Temple Scroll Column 53 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 53 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**53:1** No Ammonite or Moabite shall enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation, none of them shall ever enter the assembly of the LORD,

**53:2** because they did not meet you with food and water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia to curse you.

**53:3** But the LORD your God refused to listen to Balaam, and the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

**53:4** You shall not seek their peace or their prosperity all your days, forever.

**53:5** You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land.

**53:6** Children born to them in the third generation may enter the assembly of the LORD.

**53:7** When you go out as an army against your enemies, you shall guard yourself against every evil thing.

**53:8** If there is among you any man who is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he shall go outside the camp; he shall not enter the camp.

**53:9** And toward evening he shall bathe in water, and at sunset he may re-enter the camp.

**53:10** You shall have a designated area outside the camp where you may relieve yourself.

**53:11** And you shall have a stake among your equipment; and when you relieve yourself outside, you shall dig with it and then turn and cover your excrement.

**53:12** For the LORD your God moves about in the midst of your camp, to deliver you and to give your enemies over to you; therefore your camp must be holy, so that He does not see anything indecent among you and turn away from you.

**53:13** You shall not hand over to his master a slave who has escaped from his master to you.

**53:14** He shall dwell with you, in your midst, in whatever place he chooses within any of your towns, wherever suits him; you shall not oppress him.

**53:15** There shall be no cult prostitute among the daughters of Israel, and there shall be no cult prostitute among the sons of Israel.

**53:16** You shall not bring the wages of a prostitute or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God in payment of any vow, for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 53 reworks Deuteronomy 23:3-18. "Cult prostitute" for qedeshah/qadesh — the standard scholarly rendering that identifies the sacral-sexual context. "Nocturnal emission" makes explicit the euphemism of "night-occurrence." "Dog" in 53:16 — retained literally; likely a derogatory term for a male cult prostitute.*
